scenes.brief: Modern China, bright pastel bedroom at morning. Yun jolts upright on her bed just after a prophetic nightmare, fully clothed in demure sleepwear, long black hair disheveled, fine perspiration, shaken expression. Alarm clock on nightstand.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นสะดุ้งตื่นจากฝันร้ายในห้องนอน

scenes.brief: At the open pastel bedroom door, elderly Nanny Fang gently places one hand on Yun's upper back, noticing her sweat-damp sleepwear after the nightmare; Yun looks back in surprise. Quiet domestic side composition.
scenes.alt: แม่นมฝางสังเกตว่าคุณหนูมีเหงื่อเต็มแผ่นหลัง

scenes.brief: Intimate birthday breakfast in a wealthy contemporary family's dining room. A porcelain bowl of longevity noodles sits in front of Yun, chopsticks in hand; grandfather De sits warmly nearby, Jiu watches maternally, Wen gently pats his daughter's head. Yun quietly observes him through a smile.
scenes.alt: ครอบครัวร่วมโต๊ะบะหมี่อายุยืนในวันเกิดซ่งอวิ๋น

scenes.brief: Wide outdoor shot of a large Buddhist temple at the city outskirts. Young Yun supports the upright, vigorous grandfather De by the forearm while they slowly climb the long stone stairway. Other pilgrims in modern civilian clothes, no palace setting.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นประคองคุณปู่ขึ้นบันไดอาราม

scenes.brief: In the peaceful temple practice hall, Yun kneels across from her elderly grandmother, a compassionate Buddhist nun. After bowing she confides the dream in a low voice; her grandmother listens with kind yet penetrating eyes. Private medium two-shot in soft natural light.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นเล่าเรื่องฝันร้ายให้แม่ชีจ้าวฟัง

scenes.brief: Temple practice hall, reaction shot looking past grandmother Nun Zhao's plain monastic shoulder toward Yun. Zhao earnestly cautions her to keep the dream private and to return to her if overwhelmed. Yun visibly absorbs the warning, forearms resting on her lap, quiet atmosphere.
scenes.alt: แม่ชีจ้าวกำชับซ่งอวิ๋นให้เก็บความฝันไว้เป็นความลับ

scenes.brief: A modern cemetery in the southern part of the city. Wen kneels in grief, inserting incense at a simple stone grave. His eighteen-year-old daughter Wan stands near him in mourning clothes, fair and slender, distinctive bright phoenix-shaped eyes. Thin smoke, muted natural light, no readable inscription.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินจุดธูปหน้าหลุมศพโดยมีซ่งหว่านอยู่ข้างกาย

scenes.brief: Cemetery path, side-on medium shot. Wen determinedly leads Wan away by the hand to take her home. She appears reluctant while a fleeting subtle closed-lip smile crosses her face where he cannot see it. Stone graves recede in the background.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินจูงซ่งหว่านออกจากสุสานเพื่อพากลับบ้าน

scenes.brief: At Yun's dressing-room vanity before her birthday party, Jiu carefully fastens Yun's rose-gold diamond earring. Birthday girl wears a pale-pink satin spaghetti-strap dress with rose-gold necklace. Blue velvet jewelry box on vanity, reflective glass, intimacy of mother and daughter.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วสวมต่างหูเพชรให้ซ่งอวิ๋นก่อนงานเลี้ยงวันเกิด

scenes.brief: Contemporary private banquet hall with family tables. Sixteen-year-old cousin Zhi hurries up cheerfully toward Yun and Jiu as they arrive together. Yun in her pale pink satin party dress and diamond jewelry, candid affectionate greeting rather than a formal portrait.
scenes.alt: ซ่งจื้อรีบเข้ามาทักซ่งอวิ๋นที่เพิ่งมาถึงห้องจัดเลี้ยง

scenes.brief: At a table in the chic Song residence banquet hall, Jiang Su and his younger brother Jiang Shen offer a medium-sized wrapped birthday box to 18-year-old cousin Yun. She hugs it appreciatively, touched yet quietly uneasy. Pale pink satin birthday dress and rose-gold jewelry.
scenes.alt: เจียงซูกับเจียงเซินมอบของขวัญวันเกิดให้ซ่งอวิ๋น

characters: เจินเหมี่ยว
scenes.brief: Close angled birthday party scene around a modern sports-car key fob in surprised Yun's hand, Uncle Xuan warmly smiling as his wife Zhen Miao gently cautions Yun to drive safely. Yun remains in her pink satin dress; no actual car or prominent trademark in the hall.
scenes.alt: อาสามให้กุญแจรถเป็นของขวัญ ส่วนเจินเหมี่ยวเตือนให้ขับระวัง

scenes.brief: An eighteen-year-old woman in pale pink satin plays a creamy-white grand piano centered on the banquet stage. Respectful performing posture, fingers over the keys, downcast calm eyes. Warm stage lights, guests quietly listening in soft focus, panoramic cinematic framing.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นบรรเลงเปียโนสีขาวบนเวทีวันเกิด

scenes.brief: Song Wen introduces Wan as his daughter by the modern birthday hall's doorway. Wan stands modestly beside him, Zhou Jiu visibly in shock opposite them with Yun protectively next to her in pink satin. Stilled party guests around them, powerful four-person composition.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินเปิดเผยต่อหน้าโจวจิ่วและซ่งอวิ๋นว่าซ่งหว่านเป็นลูกสาว

scenes.brief: Yun, tearful and still in her birthday dress, supports her faint and devastated mother Jiu away from the banquet floor, Aunt Xiang helping on the other side. Soft banquet lighting trails behind as the three enter the residence. Composed non-graphic human drama.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นกับอารองช่วยประคองโจวจิ่วออกจากงาน

scenes.brief: The party has fractured. At the elegant banquet hall exit, Uncle Xuan and the two Jiang brothers apologize and quietly usher bewildered guests outside. Abandoned place settings and dimmed celebration details, respectful middle-distance composition.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเซวียนกับหลานชายช่วยส่งแขกออกจากงานเลี้ยง

scenes.brief: In the nearly emptied banquet hall Wan has spread her arms between her father, seated on the floor, and the elderly patriarch. De has stopped and holds his cane still, studying Wan's unresembling face. Show only this unnerving standstill; no blow, injury detail, or blood.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านกางแขนปกป้องพ่อ ขณะที่ผู้เฒ่าซ่งหยุดนิ่ง

scenes.brief: Large modern reception room, patriarch De seated upright on a sofa as Xuan and Wan help Wen in. From the edge of the partly open door, Yun in her pink birthday dress peeks in with reddened eyes. De notices her despite the tense conversation.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเต๋อสังเกตเห็นซ่งอวิ๋นแอบมองจากขอบประตู

scenes.brief: In the reception room, Wen pulls Wan into a protective embrace. Foreground shows Yun in profile looking up toward the ceiling from the doorway, holding back tears as she sees the embrace. Darkly reflective family drama, no visible injuries.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นกลั้นน้ำตาเมื่อเห็นบิดากอดซ่งหว่าน

scenes.brief: Wide interior: De sits composed and unyielding in the family's reception room as he makes a decisive break with Wen. Wen and Wan are shocked in the opposite seating area; Xuan and the Jiang brothers remain silent witnesses at the side. No blood or physical fighting.
scenes.alt: ผู้เฒ่าซ่งยืนยันการตัดสินใจต่อหน้าลูกหลาน

scenes.brief: In the post-banquet reception room, Wen beckons from beside Wan; Yun walks past him to stay beside grandfather De. Her posture is careful, her pink birthday dress distinct; grandfather's small gesture of acceptance contrasts with Wen's tense face.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นเลือกยืนข้างคุณปู่แทนที่จะไปอยู่กับบิดา

scenes.brief: Quiet close two-shot within the larger reception room. Yun sits next to her grandfather, tears spilling despite restraint. De comforts her with his hand on her shoulder, his eyes softened by concern. Retain her pale-pink birthday dress and modest framing.
scenes.alt: ผู้เฒ่าซ่งลูบไหล่ปลอบหลานสาวที่กำลังร้องไห้

scenes.brief: Jiu stands in the reception-room doorway gathering strength after fainting, eyes damp and bearing suddenly resolute as she announces the divorce. Wen, Wan and the rest of the room turn in surprise. Yun and De sit together inside, dramatic doorway framing.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วยืนที่ประตูและประกาศว่าจะหย่า

scenes.brief: Jiu sits beside Yun, wearing a tired but resolute expression with tears in her eyes. She turns directly to her father-in-law De to ask for support, and he calmly signals his wholehearted agreement. Intimate woman-centered reaction shot after confrontation.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วขอแรงสนับสนุนจากผู้เฒ่าซ่งและได้รับคำยืนยัน

scenes.brief: After Wen is taken outside, Jiu's composure dissolves. Daughter Yun enfolds her in a supportive hug in the now subdued reception room, both still dressed for the interrupted birthday, no injuries or melodramatic effects.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นโอบกอดแม่ที่ปล่อยโฮหลังบิดาออกไป

characters: เจินเหมี่ยว
scenes.brief: In the family reception room on birthday night, Xiang offers Jiu a glass of water, Zhen Miao reassuring her, Yun staying close to her mother. Jiu is crying but catching her breath. Glass catching light, understated family solidarity.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเซียงส่งน้ำให้โจวจิ่ว โดยมีเจินเหมี่ยวและซ่งอวิ๋นอยู่ด้วย

scenes.brief: De sits at the sofa edge, his granddaughter Yun kneeling beside him with her face hidden against his trousered knee, crying silently. His strong hand near her shoulder telegraphs protection. Gentle, grounded depiction of adult grief and family care.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นซบตักคุณปู่หลังได้รับคำปลอบใจ

scenes.brief: Night exterior lights streak past the family van window. Brothers Jiang Su and Jiang Shen disagree across the back seats about events; their mother Xiang intervenes firmly to stop the argument. Low-key modern vehicle interior, tense distinct faces.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเซียงห้ามเจียงซูกับเจียงเซินโต้เถียงกันในรถตู้

scenes.brief: Quiet modern hospital private room at night. Wan tending to recuperating Wen at his bedside, a small ointment tube in hand, worried respectful expression. Show care through gesture, fully covered, no bruises or wound detail.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านดูแลซ่งเหวินขณะพักรักษาตัวในโรงพยาบาล

scenes.brief: At Wen's second house after leaving hospital, a middle-aged family lawyer in understated charcoal suit quietly presents a thick envelope of divorce papers. Wan lightly grips Wen's sleeve and he stares at the official documents in disbelief. Contemporary foyer, no legible document writing.
scenes.alt: ทนายส่งเอกสารหย่าให้ซ่งเหวินที่บ้านอีกหลัง

scenes.brief: At the other home's table, Wen reluctantly signs the thick divorce and property settlement papers. The middle-aged family lawyer in charcoal waits quietly, Wan nearby with lowered eyes. Focus on clenched grip on pen and tense faces, no readable text.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเหวินจำใจลงนามในข้อตกลงหย่าและแบ่งทรัพย์สิน

scenes.brief: In dim bedroom light, Wen is asleep out of focus while Wan studies a framed photograph held tightly. The family photograph contains Wen, Jiu and Yun together, using their established faces; Wan's intelligent phoenix eyes conceal resentment. Do not show a damaged photograph.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านจับกรอบรูปครอบครัวแน่นขณะเฝ้าบิดานอนพัก

scenes.brief: Next morning at the Song estate, sleep-deprived Yun reads the corporate leadership news on her smartphone, subtly surprised and thoughtful. Quiet morning bedroom, light on cheek, phone angle with no generated legible text.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นอ่านข่าวเปลี่ยนผู้บริหารซ่งกรุ๊ปจากโทรศัพท์

scenes.brief: In the morning hallway, elderly Nanny Fang delivers troubling news about Jiu's fever. Yun has turned toward her mother's room and starts walking hurriedly, concern clear, Fang in the open doorway. Wide cinematic hallway with contemporary warm interiors.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นรีบไปหาแม่หลังแม่นมฝางบอกว่าแม่มีไข้

scenes.brief: Soft daylight in Jiu's large bedroom. Her daughter Yun leans down and hugs her while she rests under sheets. They smile through tears after Jiu promises to recover and cheer at the exam. Tender close framing with hands visible.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นกอดมารดาหลังได้ยินคำสัญญาว่าจะไปเชียร์วันสอบ

scenes.brief: Several days after the incident, Wan revises before the gaokao in their other home's study. Books spread out in front of her; recovering father Wen promises to wait at the exam site. She briefly looks up from her reading. Bright contemporary interior.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านอ่านหนังสือเตรียมสอบขณะซ่งเหวินคุยให้กำลังใจ

scenes.brief: At a modern shopping mall near the bookstore, Jiang Shen takes a heavy stack of study books from Wan to help her. He beams; her expression is composed and carefully pleasant. Shoppers in soft bokeh, natural action.
scenes.alt: เจียงเซินช่วยซ่งหว่านถือกองหนังสือที่ห้าง

scenes.brief: Evening before the exam at the Song residence study. Jiu sets a cup of soothing tea on the study desk while her seated daughter Yun affectionately hugs her waist. De watches with a warm, restrained smile, gentle desk lamp, modern books.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วชงชามาให้ซ่งอวิ๋นคืนก่อนสอบ โดยมีคุณปู่อยู่ด้วย

scenes.brief: Wide modern school exam entrance busy with gaokao candidates and families. Beside a sleek European van are Yun, Jiu and De. A short distance away, Wan offers a courteous bow toward De with Wen next to her. Two visibly separated groups in the crowd.
scenes.alt: สองครอบครัวเจอกันหน้าสนามสอบเมื่อซ่งหว่านค้อมศีรษะทักทาย

scenes.brief: At the exam center entrance, Yun makes a small polite bow to her mother and grandfather and turns toward the health-check queue. They encourage her with small reassuring smiles; the school crowd continues around them. Maintain daytime exam outfit continuity.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นค้อมตัวขอบคุณแม่กับคุณปู่ก่อนเข้าแถวตรวจร่างกาย

scenes.brief: Outside the school exam entrance, Wen approaches his former wife Jiu under grandfather De's watch. The formerly soft-spoken Jiu looks back with stern disapproval when Wen mentions Yun. Daylight and people in background, quiet intensity.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วปรามซ่งเหวินเมื่อเขายกเรื่องซ่งอวิ๋นขึ้นมาพูด

scenes.brief: At the exam site, De grips his cane with a tiger-head handle as he questions Wen's certainty about Wan's blood relation. Frame from hand and face in profile, son's stunned reaction opposite, no violent action.
scenes.alt: ซ่งเต๋อบีบไม้เท้าหัวพยัคฆ์ขณะถามซ่งเหวินตรง ๆ

scenes.brief: Jiu struggles to stay composed at Wen's admission about their marriage, then catches sight of daughter Yun watching from the health-check line farther away. Layer foreground mother and distant reassuring eye contact within modern school grounds.
scenes.alt: โจวจิ่วตั้งสติเมื่อสบสายตาลูกสาวจากแถวตรวจร่างกาย

scenes.brief: In the pre-exam health-check queue, rich rival student Liang Jin leans toward Yun from behind with faintly mocking concern. Yun turns to acknowledge her; other students wait in the contemporary outdoor queue. Keep gaokao outfit continuity.
scenes.alt: เหลียงจินเข้ามาพูดกระแนะกระแหนซ่งอวิ๋นในแถวตรวจร่างกาย

scenes.brief: In the queue, Yun smoothly redirects the gossip with a polite smile toward the curious candidates. They exchange embarrassed glances and turn away; Liang is visibly frustrated, Wan stays still nearby. Distinct expressions subtly framed against school buildings.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นตอบอย่างสุภาพจนคนที่มองอยู่พากันหลบสายตา

scenes.brief: Outside school before the gaokao, Nan Qiu steps forward to defend closest friend Wan from Liang Jin's embarrassing public questioning. Wan lightly tugs Nan Qiu's sleeve; Yun watches the exchange from nearby. Maintain same daytime exam outfits as chapter 9.
scenes.alt: หนานชิวออกหน้าปกป้องซ่งหว่านจากคำถามของเหลียงจิน

scenes.brief: Nan Qiu discreetly leans in to whisper a warning to Wan while Yun stands apart, slightly tilting her head with a questioning brow. Same exam queue and modern school grounds. Subtle triangular composition, avoid theatrical sneering.
scenes.alt: หนานชิวกระซิบเตือนซ่งหว่านขณะซ่งอวิ๋นยืนมอง

scenes.brief: Quiet modern Chinese gaokao exam room, rows of separated desks and proctor at the front. Yun takes a settling breath and begins writing; Wan sits at another desk. Respect test-room concentration, exam papers with no legible text.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นสูดหายใจตั้งสติก่อนเริ่มทำข้อสอบเกาเข่า

scenes.brief: After the first testing day, Wan waits just beyond the exam room door and politely calls to Yun, standing at a respectful distance. Yun pauses on her way past and studies her expression in the busy school corridor.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านดักรอหน้าห้องสอบและขอคุยกับซ่งอวิ๋น

scenes.brief: Opposite sides of a simple outdoor table under a large shade tree in front of the school building. Wan asks for forgiveness and a chance; Yun clasps her hands on the tabletop and regards her calmly, both in their same exam-day clothes. Late-afternoon heat diffused by foliage.
scenes.alt: สองพี่น้องนั่งคุยใต้ต้นไม้ใหญ่เมื่อซ่งหว่านขอโอกาส

characters.name: ซ่งอวิ๋น
characters.description: Song Yun, just turned 18. Slender, fair oval face, long glossy black hair, fine shaped brows, peach-blossom eyes, small upturned high-bridged nose, soft pink cupid’s bow lips. Poised, affectionate toward family. Ch2–6 birthday scenes: pale-pink satin spaghetti-strap dress just above knees, rose-gold diamonds, pastel star hair clip after Song Zhi gifts it in ch3. Modern setting.

characters.name: ซ่งหว่าน
characters.description: Song Wan, 18 and two months older than Yun. Delicately slender, porcelain complexion, especially expressive bright intelligent phoenix eyes inherited from her late mother. Her features do not resemble the rest of the Song family. Cool composure often concealed by modest or concerned expressions.

characters.name: ซ่งเต๋อ
characters.description: Song De, 73, still upright and energetic. Salt-and-pepper hair mostly silver with scattered black, kind toward Yun and formidable toward adults. Tiger-head cane visible at the gaokao site in chapter 9.

characters.name: โจวจิ่ว
characters.description: Zhou Jiu, elegant mature mother to Yun, strong resemblance to her daughter grounded in their dialogue. Naturally warm, graceful and soft-spoken, composed despite betrayal. Mature appearance distinct from 18-year-old Yun.

characters.name: ซ่งเหวิน
characters.description: Song Wen, middle-aged business patriarch and father of Yun and Wan. Sharp expressive eyes, usually warm to his daughters, also visibly torn and defensive. Modern formal attire appropriate to house and banquet.

characters.name: จ้าวอิ๋น
characters.description: Zhao Yin, paternal grandmother, a Buddhist nun since age 60 and presently an older woman. Compassionate face, profound soft but highly perceptive eyes, modest monastic clothing. No exact current age stated in these chapters.

characters.name: แม่นมฝาง
characters.description: Nanny Fang, elderly caring woman who has raised Yun from infancy. Warm attentive expression, understated modern household clothing.

characters.name: ซ่งเซียง
characters.description: Song Xiang, the paternal second aunt, Wen’s younger sister and mother of two adult Jiang brothers. Was widely admired for her looks when young; mature elegant bearing and openly warm manner toward her niece.

characters.name: ซ่งเซวียน
characters.description: Song Xuan, youngest paternal uncle and father of Zhi; adult man with very gentle eyes like his mother Zhao Yin. Affectionate, practical, moderates the post-party conflict.

characters.name: เจินเหมี่ยว
characters.description: Zhen Miao, Song Xuan’s wife and Yun’s third aunt by marriage. Adult woman, kind watchful gaze and reassuring demeanor. Exact age and further face details unspecified.

characters.name: เจียงซู
characters.description: Jiang Su, 22, elder son of Xiang. Soft-spoken, responsible older cousin; clear family resemblance to the Songs. Keep visually distinct from Jiang Shen, his younger brother.

characters.name: เจียงเซิน
characters.description: Jiang Shen, 20, younger son of Xiang. Modern young drummer, friendly, more impressionable than his brother. Family resemblance to the Songs; no exact physical features beyond family likeness stated.

characters.name: ซ่งจื้อ
characters.description: Song Zhi, 16, tall teenage boy with buoyant puppy-like manners, lively grin and affection for his older cousin Yun. Nephew of Jiu and only son of Xuan.

characters.name: ฮวาผิง
characters.description: Hua Ping, deceased mother of Song Wan and Wen’s longtime lover. Her distinctive phoenix eyes resemble her daughter's. Her grave appears in chapter 2; no on-screen portrait is required by chapters 1–10 scenes.

characters.name: เหลียงจิน
characters.description: Liang Jin, contemporary exam-age candidate and daughter of rival Chairman Liang. Strong social confidence and quick biting expressions. Specific face features and age not stated in chapters 9–10.

characters.name: หนานชิว
characters.description: Nan Qiu, contemporary exam-age young woman and second young lady of the Nan family; protective close friend to Wan, tense expressive gaze during the queue incident. Specific face features and age not stated in chapter 10.
